t: Acceleration due to gravity on the surface of earth is g. If the diameter of earth is reduced to one third of its original value with mass unchanged, the acceleration due to gravity becomes ____ g.
s:
The acceleration due to gravity on the surface of a spherical body of mass M and radius R is given by:
g = GM / R²

Since radius is directly proportional to diameter, reducing the diameter to one-third reduces the radius to one-third of its initial value:
R' = R / 3

Given that mass remains unchanged (M' = M), the new acceleration due to gravity g' becomes:
g' = GM / (R')²
g' = GM / (R / 3)²
g' = 9(GM / R²)
g' = 9g

Hence, the acceleration due to gravity becomes 9g.

Answer: 9
